title: Handling Overtime Constraints in Mixed Integer Linear Programming for Surgical Scheduling: A Comparison of Neural Network and Classical Linearization Techniques
summary: Uncertainty in surgery durations continues to be difficult to account for in operating room scheduling. In particular, it remains complex to accurately incorporate uncertainty in surgical overtime constraints within mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) models. Therefore, we propose a method that integrates feedforward neural networks (FNNs) into MILP models to approximate the total surgery duration in these overtime constraints.
